caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a tall, ornate lamp or candleholder, centered on a plain background. The object has a rounded, flat base that supports a long, slender, baluster-shaped stem with multiple curves and contours, widening toward the middle and narrowing above and below. The top of the stem supports a cup-like upper section with a lid, from which several short, wavy lines resembling wicks or flames protrude. The rendering is executed in grayscale pencil or charcoal, with shading used to suggest highlights, curvature, and a metallic or polished surface. The background is an off-white or beige, left mostly blank except for some faint speckling and the artist's signature in the lower right corner.
title: Pewter Lard Oil Lamp
